sourceVerification.scope: src/public/scripts/vendor and named build configs, excluding env/private/data/uploads/build output directories; not the production build private salted hash

sourceBinding.scope: Copied public release inputs: src/public/scripts/vendor plus next.config.js/package.json/pnpm-lock.yaml/tsconfig.json/postcss.config.js; excludes env/private/data/uploads/build outputs. Production build ID separately binds private build inputs.

method: Counts actual GET tRPC request procedures after 15-second startup settling. Tracks /events and /api/live request starts, completion/failure, active and overlapping requests. startsAfterPriorClose is an observed repeat connection, not proof of why it reconnected; an open request does not establish healthy SSE message delivery.
limitations: One isolated seeded jobs screen, Clerk stub; not every screen. Connection liveness is HTTP request lifetime, not server heartbeat receipt. Earlier archived 65-second observations retain their original narrower definition.
